name: The Keeper
source:
The Keeper is a bastion of knowledge. His wisdom is unparalleled, and his words are so significant that even the Queen heeds his wishes without hesitation.

He holds the keys to all the kingdom's locks, hence his title, though only he knows where they are kept.

He founded the once-mighty band, The Revenants, who played an instrumental role in combating threats, earning him the title of the de facto "king of king.".

They ended the Great war by sealing the last demon portals, but accounts of that incident are scare and dubious as no band members have been seen since.

Rumors of sightings persist for every member except the Gray Marauder, who is believed to have single-handedly struck the final blow against the demon invasion.

After the band's disbandment, the Keeper resumed his role as advisor to lords and kings, favoring Marcia, who provided a grand mansion for his base.

It's hard to imagine his brilliance at its peak, as he's now often confused, mumbling due to his now-withering intellect.

Perhaps the burden of memorizing countless keys and notes causes him to lose his train of thought.

[In game description]
